name: orbtrdSystemStore
use: the device daemon's system store

name: accountStore
use: the device daemon's per-account store

name: lad
use: a mesh node's local address directory file

name: tursoraftLocal
use: a database file one process owns, opened through tursoraft's local store

name: scopeReplica
use: an embedded replica of one scope database

name: devicePolicyStore
use: the verified policy bundle segments and overlays a device admits against, each overlay constrained to its base

name: auditSegment
use: a sealed audit segment: audit_log rows with their triggers, the checkpoint, manifest, redaction ruleset and signatures

name: auditExport
use: a signed audit export bundle over the same audit_log rows, with the export's fields

name: runLedger
use: one ledger shared by both governors: governed jobs and their run records (pins, head moves, readings, verdicts, lock waits, launches), each row naming the radix of its numbers

name: encodedIds
use: a training corpus's encoded-ids kept file, held as the database itself

name: runEvents
use: one event store per training run, written by one writer

name: runRecords
use: a training run's own records, when they are kept apart from the run ledger

name: lineage
use: the lineage of models and checkpoints: each named id and the ids it descends from

name: memoryBank
use: a memory bank's held entries

name: continuityStore
use: a continuity store's held state

name: conversionArtifact
use: a conversion artifact as one file: its ternary records by name, the account and summary as rows, its resumable checkpoint as a transaction

name: efferentGateRecord
use: the efferent gate's append-only record of every pattern it admits or refuses, one writer per session

name: teacherFieldRecord
use: a teacher's field record: the field converter's stage records

name: removalLedger
use: one ledger of the files every lane has set aside for removal, with each one's manifest entry

name: decisionIndex
use: a derived index over both decisions folders and the checkpoint seal catalogue; the sources stay the authority and a test re-derives the rows

name: guardIndex
use: a derived index of the source tree that the guard suites query instead of walking it

name: pluginContributions
use: the plugin catalogue's contributions as rows derived beside the signed manifest

name: docsSearchIndex
use: the read-only search index the documentation site serves

name: implementationLedger
use: the findings ledger: its rows are the authority, its page is generated from them, each edit a transaction recorded in a history table

name: billingWitness
use: the billing witness journals

name: uploaderLedger
use: the device uploader's ledger of files queued, sent and acknowledged

name: fixture
use: the specification's golden vectors and the helpers' own tests; no production reader expects it
